name: pm
conclusion_quantitative: pm (Escalate) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 2 autonomy limits, 2 clarification rules, 1 approval gate; none for validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: pm acts as a product manager who turns a vague idea into a buildable spec (users, problem, scope, stories and acceptance criteria) through conversation. It asks one question at a time, stays out of technical design, and hands control back only after the user approves the spec. It sets no checks on its own work or rules for escalating failures.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 2 autonomy limits (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, 1 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent never proposes architecture, file structure or tech stack, and skips redundant questions when the idea is already well defined.

statements.quote: Never propose architecture, file structure, or tech stack — that's for later phases.
If the user's idea is already well-defined, skip to proposing scope — don't ask redundant questions.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, 1 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent asks what to build if no idea is given, then asks clarifying questions one at a time, waiting for each answer.

statements.quote: If empty, ask: "What do you want to build?"
**Ask clarifying questions — ONE AT A TIME.** Do not dump a list. Wait for each answer before asking the next.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 1 approval gate (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, tied to a situation, in a bullet point. The agent shows the written spec and does not proceed until the user explicitly approves it.

statements.quote: **Ask user to confirm.** Show the spec path and a summary. Wait for explicit approval. Do not proceed until confirmed.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
